nom: Ebanel 10-Pack Collagen Face Mask with Hyaluronic Acid

avis.texte: These masks are just wonderful! The thick hydrogel hugs your face snugly, holds more liquid and stays moister far longer than the paper type sheet masks, enabling the serum/essence to absorb deeply into your skin. Just for clarification, I believe the 5 pack masks are hydrogel, while the 10 pack are paper sheet masks. Hydrogel is a thick gummy or jelly like material, which I had never tried before, but now that I have, I really feel it is far superior to the paper or fiber sheet masks. Aside from the hydrogel, a couple of the other features I especially appreciate about these masks are; 1. They are super moist, packed with serum. A little too much, which is great, because before removing from the pouch, I open a corner of the package, and using a funnel, squeeze out some of the excess into a clean serum bottle for later use. I've been getting about 1/4 ounce of excess serum from each mask, enough to continue treating my face with, every day for a week. While leaving more than enough in the mask itself, to stay nice and moist for a good 30 minutes or more. 2. Other masks have clogged my pore and made me break out, or left my face with a "sticky" feeling. But after using these, my face feels smooth, soft and well hydrated, creating a great base for applying makeup. The improvement in my skin is definitely noticeable! 3. The ingredients are rather impressive, especially for the price! Lots of botanical extracts, stem cells, minerals, hyarolonic acid, collagen, etc., and NO alcoh

avis.titre: Amazing for my dry sensitive skin! They’ve got a return customer
avis.texte: I just bought these for a second time because they are great. I wasn’t expecting such great quality and results for the low price. My skin feels so soft for the entire day after using. It is very moisturizing and leaves skin smooth. I have very sensitive, dry skin, and it hasn’t caused me any issues. Each mask comes with plenty serum that I use on my neck. I don’t usually write reviews, but this deserved it

I found these masks to be sufficent in providing some moisture to my face, just enough that I didn't need to apply moisturizer afterward. They don't have as much product on the sheets as other masks I've tried, but it still felt nice. I did find the mask to be something of a pain to adjust on my face. The opening for the mouth was huge and hung down below my chin! The eye openings were surprisingly narrow, so there was this slight annoyance with feeling my eyelashes catch on it overtime I blinked. I will say that it did not help with the really dry and flaky patches on my skin. I actually had one crop up on my cheek right before I tried these masks, so it was perfect timing. When I applied the mask, it stung a little a first (I have really sensitive skin apparently) but it only lasted for a couple of seconds and then it was fine. Afterward, the majority of my skin was fine but that dry patched seemed a little irritated so I did have to moisturize that particular area. So I think this mask would be great for normal to slightly dry skin, but if you're having that winter dry skin where it's really flaky and sensitive, this mask may not provide enough moisture. I think when it gets more toward summer, this masks will be perfect for when my skin is less dry. These are definitely worth checking out.

avis.titre: Excellent for hydrating and calming irritating skin
avis.texte: This is amazing if you have sensitive or irritated skin. I live in MN and the winters are very drying and my skin can become tight and irritated with the cold and wind. I also have very sensitive skin and was hesitant to try it because I tend to react to several products. The ingredients all looked soothing and nourishing, so I gave it a try and am so glad I did. At first my skin tingled and I almost removed the mask to wash it off, but then the tingling stopped and I stuck it out for the 20 minutes. When I took the mask off, my skin was hydrated, soothed and glowing. I recently traveled to Arizona and put 3 in my suitcase, since I figured my face would be dehydrated from the airplane and the dry heat in AZ. I was traveling with my sister and purposely brought one for her to try. She couldn't believe how amazing her skin felt and how it calmed some of her breakouts/red areas. (She already ordered her own from Amazon while we were waiting at the airport for our return flight home). I've already repurchase this product and will continue to use. I love it!!

I absolutely LOVE these masks so much, just exactly what I've needed for some help with pampering and dry skin. Colorado is such a dry climate, and after I use these, my skin feels dewey, just like I had a facial. I will be building these into my routine for sure!
Best face mask ever! My skin feels so hydrated, and I've already noticed a glow after using it just twice a week.
It is an okay product. I don’t think the quality is very good. You pretty much get what you paid for. Does provide some glow but not very effective. Had some redness to the face when using this item.
These paper facemasks actually work. Hydrated skin and is firm after. Continuous buy for me

avis.titre: Ebanol collagen face mask feels so refreshing!
avis.texte: Feels cool, I put it on after my shower. Makes my skin look lifted and dewy! Makeup seems to blend better after I use it.

avis.titre: At seventy two years old, this is a game changer
avis.texte: I put mines in the refrigerator. I do egg white facials once a week. Once I take off the egg white, I put the mask on to soften my skin.. The glow is real... One last thing before I put the mask on, I usually dip my face in a bowl of ice cold water.. I look like I just got off of a Ski slope

This a very good face mask if used as directed . Leaves face moisturized . I was looking for a regular moisturizing sheet face mask anddecided to give this a try and I wasn't disappointed its affordable and works good. Not the best of the best but good overall. Will recommend to a friend .

I love the results of this mask but I have a very difficult time getting it to stick to my face. In the picture you can see that it is not sticking to my upper lip or chin. I think there isn’t enough product on the mask to make it adhere.

From the moment I took the mask out of the package the ingredients were cool to the touch and immediately my fingers felt soft I applied the mask for 30 min it states 20 to 40 min however at 30 the mask was drying out so I removed and blotted my face. It was refreshing, relaxing my skin felt soft afterwards and smooth to the touch, there are 10 to a pk and the recommended use is 2-3 times per week. Highly recommended! I felt like I had been at a spa. Great value

This is by far one of my favorite masks!!! I apply it 3 days a week and, while wearing it, I do my morning stretching and breathing routine. Is soothing and cooling and makes your face feel amazing!!! I get so many compliments on my skin. Thank you for this product🌟♥️

I was skeptical to be honest. But I’m 100% on board with results they were fabulous my skin is soft and replenished my cheeks were dry and rough needed something to help when moisturizer failed. Figured for the price it was worth the risk and I am not disappointed I will order more and continue to use. Side note. Stays in place much better if leaning back or laying down :-)

avis.titre: Excellent Sheet Mask "Bang for the Buck"
avis.texte: I am on my 2nd pack of these masks and I want another pack. I love how my skin looks and feels after I use them; and I can especially see the glow the next morning. I have mature skin, and these work very well for my skin. Just be delicate when unfolding them, so you do not tear them. A little patience is needed, but it is worth it!
I bought these masks for after microneedling. Love them! Soo soothing, smell nice and great for sensitive skin.

Easy to apply. Stays on great. I accidentally took a nap🙇🏻‍♀️ On my recliner and mask never moved. My skin feels great. Will repeat 3 x a week for 1 month and give an update. Still new to facial products so trying different companies out. For the price it’s affordable Plus you can wear your glasses over the paper gel mask!!!
I use these after I derma roll my face and it cools down my face instantly....I love them and will be buying more. 😁😁😁

I had a bad reaction to these, and I do not generally have sensitive skin. My face was fine right after. The next morning my face was red and puffy and my eyes where super swollen. I had burning. 2 days later it’s still bad.

Living in the dry climate I needed something to REALLY hydrate my dry skin. This face mask does amazing job. I think this is the best face mask I’ve ever used. It has so much serum in a mask that after 20 minuets of apply I still had some for my neck, elbow and knee! Next day my daughter commented that my skin feels like baby’s bottom!

I’m a beauty/cosmetic addict, in love with this face mask, I’ve already ordered many times. I found one was empty-no mask in it the other night. I was disappointed. I’m sure it was mistake, but I’m thinking I should get partial refund or something. Anyway, it’s good price and great quality I’ve ever use.
These are well moisturized and calming I just think there to short and don’t fit all the way to the end of my face like other face mask do
I appear hydrated. I feel hydrated. The pic looks like it might be oil but it isn’t.

The mask Does Not Have Good Skin Adherence. The mask has a lot of slits all around and it wrinkles up and puckers up on the skin. Then the mask starts to dry up fast and lacks skin adherence. Very cheap mask and the eyes don't line up. The eyes on the mask is too big. Also there is not enough ingredient liquid it feels dry. Usually there is more liquid on the bottom of other mask pouch I bought but this one there is NO left over liquid AT ALL. I would not recommend this mask to anyone. Hopeless mask. Awful. Do not buy.
Love! Makes you feel and look younger. I have learned to just lay in bed with it on at night and sometimes in the morning too.

I had no problems with this face mask before and I have been using it for a while now. Today I opened the face mask and there was a hair stuck in it. It was absolutely disgusting, do better. How does a hair even get stuck in there!?? I will DEFINITELY not be buying from this brand anymore.

I was really excited to try these, the first time I did it it was really cold when applying the mask, after about 10 seconds on my face it started burning. I kept it on for about 5 more minutes to see if it would go away, but it didn’t. I peeled a piece on my forehead away to see and it was super red so I took the whole thing off. I might try it again idk. Wasn’t a big fan..
